title: System Endpoints
summary: This module provides core API endpoints for application lifecycle management, health checks, and metadata retrieval for the chat interface, ensuring the system is operational and correctly configured.

nodes.label: Manage Application Lifespan
nodes.title: Application Lifespan Management
nodes.description: Handles the startup and shutdown phases of the FastAPI application, including model loading and resource initialization based on environment variables like HF_TOKEN.

nodes.label: Retrieve Chat Metadata
nodes.title: Chat Metadata Endpoint
nodes.description: Provides metadata for the four-gate chat UI, including system prompts, default questions, configuration paths, and explanations for steering mechanisms, by loading data from the D&D playground bundle.

nodes.label: Perform Health Check
nodes.title: System Health Check
nodes.description: Reports the operational status of various system components, including model loading, SAE status, persona steering vector loading, and D&D playground bundle status.

nodes.label: D&D Playground Endpoints
nodes.title: D&D Playground Endpoints
nodes.description: Provides API endpoints specifically for the Dungeons & Dragons playground functionality, allowing interaction with its features.

nodes.label: SAE Endpoints
nodes.title: SAE Endpoints
nodes.description: Offers API endpoints for interacting with Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) functionalities, such as comparing and snapshotting SAE states.

nodes.label: Chat Interface Endpoints
nodes.title: Chat Interface Endpoints
nodes.description: Exposes API endpoints for various chat functionalities, including streaming, persona steering, and different chat modes.

groups.label: Initialization & Status
groups.title: Application Initialization and Status
groups.description: Components responsible for setting up the application environment, loading necessary models, and reporting the system's current health and configuration.

groups.label: Metadata & Configuration
groups.title: Metadata and Configuration Services
groups.description: Endpoints that provide essential metadata and configuration details to other modules, particularly for the chat interface and its steering mechanisms.
